title: Book One · Chapter 180: Enough?
story:
On Sunday morning, Ronan puts his saved money on the table.

He makes small piles. He counts each pile twice.

Mum sits across from him with a piece of paper. Dad has a cup of tea in one hand.

“There,” Ronan says.

Mum writes the number down.

Then she writes their birthday gift amount. She and Dad put that money aside for him.

“This part is from us.”

Ronan looks at the two numbers.

“Together?”

“Yes.”

He adds slowly. Dad waits. He does not say the answer first.

Ronan writes his number under Mum’s.

“Enough?”

“Mr Qiu told us the price. Together, our money is enough for it,” Mum says.

Ronan smiles.

Dad puts down his cup.

“We must still look at the bike.”

“I know.”

“If it needs work, that may cost more.”

Ronan stops smiling for a moment. He has counted the price, but not the cost of repairs.

“You can fix it.”

“Some things. Is anything wrong with the bike? We do not know yet.”

Ronan thinks of the paper bridge. They fixed that with folded paper. A bike may need new parts. New parts cost money.

“Then we check.”

“Then we check,” Dad agrees.

Mum finds an envelope. She puts the money inside and writes on the front.

Ronan can read his name and the word bike.

“If we do not buy it?” he asks.

“We bring the money home.”

“Even if we go all the way there?”

“Yes.”

Dad takes a sip of tea.

“Even after a long walk, we can say no. We need a safe bike for you.”

Ronan laughs, though he hopes it will be a good one.

They agree to go after lunch. Ronan puts his things in order that morning. He wants to leave a clear place for the bell. He hopes they will put it on the bike later.

He puts the book straight on the shelf. The wooden boat goes beside it.

The bell sits between them.

Ronan picks it up, then puts it down.

He goes to the kitchen.

“Can I take the bell?”

Mum looks at Dad.

“Will it fit? We can check,” Dad says.

Ronan puts it in his pocket.

After lunch, the three of them walk to Mr Qiu’s place. He writes an address on a small piece of paper.

“The house with the low wall,” he says. “She knows you may come.”

Mum thanks him.

Ronan keeps his hand near his pocket as they walk. He can feel the round bell through the cloth.

They pass two boys on bikes. One rides slowly beside the other. Neither boy looks at Ronan.

For a moment, he wants to run ahead to the address.

But he does not know the way yet.

“Left here?” he asks.

Mum checks the paper.

“The next left.”

Ronan waits for them. At the low wall, he sees a blue handlebar above the gate.

His heart begins to beat faster.

Dad knocks.

A woman comes to the door. She looks at Ronan, then at his pocket. The round bell makes the cloth stick out.

“You must be here for the bike.”

Ronan takes his hand away from his pocket.

“We are here to look at it,” he says.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达
- pile：一小堆。
- amount：数额。
- put aside：留出、存下。
- envelope：信封。

## 理解
1. 买车预算由哪两部分组成？
2. 一家人为什么约定可以不买就回来？
